symptom: ako/mxcli#721 L5: describe -> exec of a Studio Pro List View whose Database source is reached over an association from a snippet parameter (TestApp WorkflowCommons Snip_*_Assignees/TargetUsers/TargetGroups) re-typed Forms$ListViewXPathSource as Forms$AssociationSource: Search, SortBar and XPathConstraint dropped, and DestinationEntity Administration.Account became System.User. check, exec and mx check all clean.
cause: parseDataSource read any entity-backed source whose EntityRef has Steps as an association source (the #941 reading for pluggable XPath sources) and printed `$Ctx/Assoc`, which executes as an in-memory association retrieve. MDL had no spelling for a database retrieve over an association, and the association builder re-derives the destination from the association, losing a stored specialization. The writer also wrote list view lists with marker 3 and omitted the null SourceVariable key Studio Pro stores (164/164 SortItems, 44/44 SearchRefs, 45/45 Templates at marker 2 in the fixtures). Fix: New spelling `database from $Ctx/Assoc/Entity [where] [sort by] [search by]` (grammar alternative on DATABASE, AST AssociationPath). Describe prints it for Forms$ListViewXPathSource with an IndirectEntityRef, every hop's stored DestinationEntity spelled out; builder resolves it into DatabaseSource.EntitySteps + ContextVariable; listViewSourceToGen writes IndirectEntityRef + SourceVariable. Refused off a list view, in alter page set, and on the MCP backend. Codec: RegisterPropertyListMarker 2 for GridSortBar.SortItems, ListViewSearch.SearchRefs, ListView.Templates; ListViewXPathSource NullFields SourceVariable.
insight: A stored $Type is the kind; the presence of association steps is not. Two sources can share an IndirectEntityRef and still be different retrieves (database vs in-memory). Print a stored DestinationEntity rather than re-deriving it: Studio Pro stores specializations of the association's end.
